answer: Proposal: lease a fixed trellis of S reward seats per epoch by open auction, rent burned. Only the seated key earns; payout vests at a glacier pace in-epoch. The seat atlas never adds pages: unseated clones earn nothing, and a farm holding K of S seats caps at K/S of the pool while its own bids raise the rent on all K. Open entry pushes rent toward expected seat reward, so profit on extra identities tends to zero -- splitting buys seats, not yield. Limits: the rich still buy influence; a bid ring suppressing rent reopens the margin. This prices sybils, it does not detect them.
